result.reason: The clause reaches an acceptable playbook position by covering affiliates and contractors acting on their behalf and permitting transfer to a successor in an M&A transaction. Although it does not add the preferred perpetual/irrevocable or subscription-termination protections, it satisfies the stated fallback. The edits are limited to licence users and M&A transferability, preserve the Authorized Location and fee limitations, and are professionally drafted, subject only to minor potential ambiguity in “their behalf.”
